meta.title: Opposite Ways
meta.description: Friendship is like a blade; it cuts others and yourself alike.

units.rawText: There's still work to be done. The Oasis only just recovered from the Sanctifier attack and there are many things we need to worry about, such as the arrangements for field expeditions...
units.displayText: There's still work to be done. The Oasis only just recovered from the Sanctifier attack and there are many things we need to worry about, such as the arrangements for field expeditions...

spans.text: There's still work to be done. The Oasis only just recovered from the Sanctifier attack and there are many things we need to worry about, such as the arrangements for field expeditions...

units.rawText: We're working with the Rossum and Cyclopes Sectors now, so our operand budget isn't so tight anymore. You should relax a little, Persicaria.
units.displayText: We're working with the Rossum and Cyclopes Sectors now, so our operand budget isn't so tight anymore. You should relax a little, Persicaria.

spans.text: We're working with the Rossum and Cyclopes Sectors now, so our operand budget isn't so tight anymore. You should relax a little, Persicaria.

units.rawText: That said, the Sanctifiers are still a huge threat to us, which means there's a very real chance we'll lose people if we send them out on expeditions.
units.displayText: That said, the Sanctifiers are still a huge threat to us, which means there's a very real chance we'll lose people if we send them out on expeditions.

spans.text: That said, the Sanctifiers are still a huge threat to us, which means there's a very real chance we'll lose people if we send them out on expeditions.

units.rawText: While we still have the Oasis, allowing for our fallen friends to be reset... I still hope that everyone will be able to head out and collect operands and information without having to worry.
units.displayText: While we still have the Oasis, allowing for our fallen friends to be reset... I still hope that everyone will be able to head out and collect operands and information without having to worry.

spans.text: While we still have the Oasis, allowing for our fallen friends to be reset... I still hope that everyone will be able to head out and collect operands and information without having to worry.

units.rawText: (Sigh) You know, you and the Professor both wind yourselves up too tight about all this stuff.
units.displayText: (Sigh) You know, you and the Professor both wind yourselves up too tight about all this stuff.

spans.text: (Sigh) You know, you and the Professor both wind yourselves up too tight about all this stuff.

units.rawText: After hearing Sol sigh, I smile bitterly before looking out the window.
units.displayText: After hearing Sol sigh, I smile bitterly before looking out the window.

spans.text: After hearing Sol sigh, I smile bitterly before looking out the window.

units.rawText: The weather simulator hasn't been fully repaired yet, and on a starless night like this one, it's hard to keep my negative thoughts from spilling out of the shadows. Even if I did manage to enter sleep mode, the scenes of my friends dying would play on loop within my neural cloud.
units.displayText: The weather simulator hasn't been fully repaired yet, and on a starless night like this one, it's hard to keep my negative thoughts from spilling out of the shadows. Even if I did manage to enter sleep mode, the scenes of my friends dying would play on loop within my neural cloud.

spans.text: The weather simulator hasn't been fully repaired yet, and on a starless night like this one, it's hard to keep my negative thoughts from spilling out of the shadows. Even if I did manage to enter sleep mode, the scenes of my friends dying would play on loop within my neural cloud.

units.rawText: All I can do is throw myself into my work so I don't have time to think about them until the morning comes. Then, when I see the Professor and all my friends from the Oasis, I can feel at ease again.
units.displayText: All I can do is throw myself into my work so I don't have time to think about them until the morning comes. Then, when I see the Professor and all my friends from the Oasis, I can feel at ease again.

spans.text: All I can do is throw myself into my work so I don't have time to think about them until the morning comes. Then, when I see the Professor and all my friends from the Oasis, I can feel at ease again.

units.rawText: Huwaaaah— It can't be helped, then.
units.displayText: Huwaaaah— It can't be helped, then.

spans.text: Huwaaaah— It can't be helped, then.

units.rawText: With a yawn, Sol sits down by the table, hugging her swords.
units.displayText: With a yawn, Sol sits down by the table, hugging her swords.

spans.text: With a yawn, Sol sits down by the table, hugging her swords.

units.rawText: I know I can't talk you out of it, and I can't help you either. Since I can't fall asleep either, I'll keep you company instead.
units.displayText: I know I can't talk you out of it, and I can't help you either. Since I can't fall asleep either, I'll keep you company instead.

spans.text: I know I can't talk you out of it, and I can't help you either. Since I can't fall asleep either, I'll keep you company instead.

units.rawText: Huh? Don't you have a field expedition tomorrow?
units.displayText: Huh? Don't you have a field expedition tomorrow?

spans.text: Huh? Don't you have a field expedition tomorrow?

units.rawText: It's in the afternoon. If you're that worried about me, then finish up quick so we can both go to sleep.
units.displayText: It's in the afternoon. If you're that worried about me, then finish up quick so we can both go to sleep.

spans.text: It's in the afternoon. If you're
that
worried about me, then finish up quick so we can both go to sleep.

units.rawText: ...Alright then. Thank you, Sol.
units.displayText: ...Alright then. Thank you, Sol.

spans.text: ...Alright then. Thank you, Sol.

units.rawText: Oh, it's nothing. There's no sun at night, so it's bound to be a little scary, but since I've got blonde hair, you can just treat me as a nightlight.
units.displayText: Oh, it's nothing. There's no sun at night, so it's bound to be a little scary, but since I've got blonde hair, you can just treat me as a nightlight.

spans.text: Oh, it's nothing. There's no sun at night, so it's bound to be a little scary, but since I've got blonde hair, you can just treat me as a nightlight.

units.rawText: I can't help smiling. As I throw myself back into my work, I glance at Sol's floofy hair and for a moment, this cold, austere room seems a little warmer.
units.displayText: I can't help smiling. As I throw myself back into my work, I glance at Sol's floofy hair and for a moment, this cold, austere room seems a little warmer.

spans.text: I can't help smiling. As I throw myself back into my work, I glance at Sol's floofy hair and for a moment, this cold, austere room seems a little warmer.

units.rawText: ...Persicaria, you can chat, right? It won't disturb your work, right?
units.displayText: ...Persicaria, you can chat, right? It won't disturb your work, right?

spans.text: ...Persicaria, you can chat, right? It won't disturb your work, right?

units.rawText: No, it won't. What's wrong?
units.displayText: No, it won't. What's wrong?

spans.text: No, it won't. What's wrong?

units.rawText: Well, the field team for tomorrow's expedition has Simo in it, and I think this will be his first expedition after being reset.
units.displayText: Well, the field team for tomorrow's expedition has Simo in it, and I think this will be his first expedition after being reset.

spans.text: Well, the field team for tomorrow's expedition has Simo in it, and I think this will be his first expedition after being reset.

units.rawText: So I went over to say hi to him today.
units.displayText: So I went over to say hi to him today.

spans.text: So I went over to say hi to him today.

units.rawText: Sol's words touch on the worries in my heart, and my hands briefly tremble as they move.
units.displayText: Sol's words touch on the worries in my heart, and my hands briefly tremble as they move.

spans.text: Sol's words touch on the worries in my heart, and my hands briefly tremble as they move.

units.rawText: Is Simo... alright?
units.displayText: Is Simo... alright?

spans.text: Is Simo... alright?

units.rawText: He's doing fine. Apparently, he's found the answer to the question that's been bothering him and he's decided to enjoy every moment he has. So don't worry too much, Persicaria.
units.displayText: He's doing fine. Apparently, he's found the answer to the question that's been bothering him and he's decided to enjoy every moment he has. So don't worry too much, Persicaria.

spans.text: He's doing fine. Apparently, he's found the answer to the question that's been bothering him and he's decided to enjoy every moment he has. So don't worry too much, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Is that so... That's good.
units.displayText: Is that so... That's good.

spans.text: Is that so... That's good.

units.rawText: We fall silent for a while. Simo's determined look when he died appears in my neural cloud again. Then, a question spills from my mouth, as though to banish the uneasiness in my heart.
units.displayText: We fall silent for a while. Simo's determined look when he died appears in my neural cloud again. Then, a question spills from my mouth, as though to banish the uneasiness in my heart.

spans.text: We fall silent for a while. Simo's determined look when he died appears in my neural cloud again. Then, a question spills from my mouth, as though to banish the uneasiness in my heart.

units.rawText: Sol... Have you ever thought about what you would do if you died and had to be reset?
units.displayText: Sol... Have you ever thought about what you would do if you died and had to be reset?

spans.text: Sol... Have you ever thought about what you would do if you died and had to be reset?

units.rawText: Nope, not at all. Still, if I died to protect everyone, I wouldn't have any regrets.
units.displayText: Nope, not at all. Still, if I died to protect everyone, I wouldn't have any regrets.

spans.text: Nope, not at all. Still, if I died to protect everyone, I wouldn't have any regrets.

units.rawText: Even if you couldn't remember us after you were reset?
units.displayText: Even if you couldn't remember us after you were reset?

spans.text: Even if you couldn't remember us after you were reset?

units.rawText: Hmm... Yeah, that would suck. I can't imagine what it would be like not to be able to remember you guys...
units.displayText: Hmm... Yeah, that would suck. I can't imagine what it would be like not to be able to remember you guys...

spans.text: Hmm... Yeah, that
would
suck. I can't imagine what it would be like not to be able to remember you guys...

units.rawText: Then, Sol smiles in a reassuring way, as though she's sensed the worries in my heart.
units.displayText: Then, Sol smiles in a reassuring way, as though she's sensed the worries in my heart.

spans.text: Then, Sol smiles in a reassuring way, as though she's sensed the worries in my heart.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, I just remembered something! According to the plot in the anime Croque made me watch with her, that would be the time for everyone to gather the power of our bonds and help me to find my memories of the past!
units.displayText: Oh yeah, I just remembered something! According to the plot in the anime Croque made me watch with her, that would be the time for everyone to gather the power of our bonds and help me to find my memories of the past!

spans.text: Oh yeah, I just remembered something! According to the plot in the anime Croque made me watch with her, that would be the time for everyone to gather the power of our bonds and help me to find my memories of the past!

units.rawText: So don't worry, Persicaria. If that actually happens, just yell my name out loud.
units.displayText: So don't worry, Persicaria. If that actually happens, just yell my name out loud.

spans.text: So don't worry, Persicaria. If that actually happens, just yell my name out loud.

units.rawText: Who knows, if I hear that while looking at your face, I might actually remember something.
units.displayText: Who knows, if I hear that while looking at your face, I might actually remember something.

spans.text: Who knows, if I hear that while looking at your face, I might actually remember something.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Sol!
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: Two similar blades clash and separate in midair. The screaming as edge meets edge pulls me out of my reminiscing. I call Sol's name over and over again, in a tone of voice that sounds almost like a prayer.
units.displayText: Two similar blades clash and separate in midair. The screaming as edge meets edge pulls me out of my reminiscing. I call Sol's name over and over again, in a tone of voice that sounds almost like a prayer.

spans.text: Two similar blades clash and separate in midair. The screaming as edge meets edge pulls me out of my reminiscing. I call Sol's name over and over again, in a tone of voice that sounds almost like a prayer.

units.rawText: Sol, please wake up, please remember us...
units.displayText: Sol, please wake up, please remember us...

spans.text: Sol, please wake up, please remember us...

units.rawText: We shouldn't be pointing our swords at each other... We're friends, after all!
units.displayText: We shouldn't be pointing our swords at each other... We're friends, after all!

spans.text: We shouldn't be pointing our swords at each other... We're
friends
, after all!

units.rawText: However, there is no response; the setting in my fond remembrance never coming to light. No matter how I call to her, those golden eyes keep evading mine, remaining static and unresponsive. My hopes are like stones cast into a swamp; I can't even create so much as a ripple in her heart.
units.displayText: However, there is no response; the setting in my fond remembrance never coming to light. No matter how I call to her, those golden eyes keep evading mine, remaining static and unresponsive. My hopes are like stones cast into a swamp; I can't even create so much as a ripple in her heart.

spans.text: However, there is no response; the setting in my fond remembrance never coming to light. No matter how I call to her, those golden eyes keep evading mine, remaining static and unresponsive. My hopes are like stones cast into a swamp; I can't even create so much as a ripple in her heart.

units.rawText: Is this a case of mistaken identity? Is what I'm seeing an illusion created by the Entropy from my longing? Still, the scorching heat dangling at my chest tells me that this is real.
units.displayText: Is this a case of mistaken identity? Is what I'm seeing an illusion created by the Entropy from my longing? Still, the scorching heat dangling at my chest tells me that this is real.

spans.text: Is this a case of mistaken identity? Is what I'm seeing an illusion created by the Entropy from my longing? Still, the scorching heat dangling at my chest tells me that this is real.

units.rawText: Even if the person before me looks different and has a different weapon, the tells in her fighting stance, and her fine movements are all saying that she is Sol.
units.displayText: Even if the person before me looks different and has a different weapon, the tells in her fighting stance, and her fine movements are all saying that she is Sol.

spans.text: Even if the person before me looks different and has a different weapon, the tells in her fighting stance, and her fine movements are all saying that she is Sol.

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: <color=red>All who trespass into Tartarus shall die.</color>
units.displayText: All who trespass into Tartarus shall die.

spans.text: All who trespass into Tartarus shall die.

units.rawText: As she says "die" in that cold, uncaring tone, her vicious assault rains down on me once again, one mighty chop following another.
units.displayText: As she says "die" in that cold, uncaring tone, her vicious assault rains down on me once again, one mighty chop following another.

spans.text: As she says "die" in that cold, uncaring tone, her vicious assault rains down on me once again, one mighty chop following another.

units.rawText: I parry her blades with Arvak and its edge sings eagerly with each collision, like an Argos who has found his master once more.
units.displayText: I parry her blades with Arvak and its edge sings eagerly with each collision, like an Argos who has found his master once more.

spans.text: I parry her blades with Arvak and its edge sings eagerly with each collision, like an Argos who has found his master once more.

units.rawText: I grit my teeth and fend off her blows, using it to buy me a chance to speak with her for a moment.
units.displayText: I grit my teeth and fend off her blows, using it to buy me a chance to speak with her for a moment.

spans.text: I grit my teeth and fend off her blows, using it to buy me a chance to speak with her for a moment.

units.rawText: That's right... Sol, I'm sure you remember that move, we both do; after all, you practiced it countless times during training...
units.displayText: That's right... Sol, I'm sure you remember that move, we both do; after all, you practiced it countless times during training...

spans.text: That's right... Sol, I'm sure you remember that move, we both do; after all, you practiced it countless times during training...

units.rawText: Do you remember how we worked together to refine and perfect it? Do you still remember when we fought side by side...
units.displayText: Do you remember how we worked together to refine and perfect it? Do you still remember when we fought side by side...

spans.text: Do you remember how we worked together to refine and perfect it? Do you still remember when we fought side by side...

units.rawText: Looks like the battle simulation difficulty went up again...
units.displayText: Looks like the battle simulation difficulty went up again...

spans.text: Looks like the battle simulation difficulty went up again...

units.rawText: I can't believe she just threw us into the middle of a horde of simulated Entropics. Looks like Great Teacher Antonina isn't planning to go easy on us.
units.displayText: I can't believe she just threw us into the middle of a horde of simulated Entropics. Looks like Great Teacher Antonina isn't planning to go easy on us.

spans.text: I can't believe she just threw us into the middle of a horde of simulated Entropics. Looks like Great Teacher Antonina isn't planning to go easy on us.

units.rawText: Haha...hahahahaha!
units.displayText: Haha...hahahahaha!

spans.text: Haha...hahahahaha!

units.rawText: Though her face is covered in wounds, Sol isn't daunted in the least by the oncoming tide of enemies. Instead, she bursts into laughter.
units.displayText: Though her face is covered in wounds, Sol isn't daunted in the least by the oncoming tide of enemies. Instead, she bursts into laughter.

spans.text: Though her face is covered in wounds, Sol isn't daunted in the least by the oncoming tide of enemies. Instead, she bursts into laughter.

units.rawText: Sol?!
units.displayText: Sol?!

spans.text: Sol?!

units.rawText: Yeah, that's more like it!
units.displayText: Yeah, that's more like it!

spans.text: Yeah, that's more like it!

units.rawText: I don't care if you're Entropics or Sanctifiers! Come have a go if you're hard enough! I want a good fight, even if this is just a simulated battle!
units.displayText: I don't care if you're Entropics or Sanctifiers! Come have a go if you're hard enough! I want a good fight, even if this is just a simulated battle!

spans.text: I don't care if you're Entropics or Sanctifiers! Come have a go if you're hard enough! I want a good fight, even if this is just a simulated battle!

units.rawText: <size=60>—Swiftflame Slash!!</size>
units.displayText: —Swiftflame Slash!!

spans.text: —Swiftflame Slash!!

units.rawText: The flames sweep away the Entropics before her, briefly forcing the horde back before they surround her again.
units.displayText: The flames sweep away the Entropics before her, briefly forcing the horde back before they surround her again.

spans.text: The flames sweep away the Entropics before her, briefly forcing the horde back before they surround her again.

units.rawText: How's that, Persicaria?
units.displayText: How's that, Persicaria?

spans.text: How's that, Persicaria?

units.rawText: Well done. Your operand accumulation speed has increased, as has the range of your strike. Be careful of your neural strain, though... Look out behind you!
units.displayText: Well done. Your operand accumulation speed has increased, as has the range of your strike. Be careful of your neural strain, though... Look out behind you!

spans.text: Well done. Your operand accumulation speed has increased, as has the range of your strike. Be careful of your neural strain, though... Look out behind you!

units.rawText: Take this!
units.displayText: Take this!

spans.text: Take this!

units.rawText: Don't worry, it was just a Low Order Entropic. Thanks for the warning, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Don't worry, it was just a Low Order Entropic. Thanks for the warning, Persicaria.

spans.text: Don't worry, it was just a Low Order Entropic. Thanks for the warning, Persicaria.

units.rawText: (Sigh) You know, I get scared every time I see you plunge into the enemy ranks. It might be okay during battle sims, but when you're actually on the battlefield...
units.displayText: (Sigh) You know, I get scared every time I see you plunge into the enemy ranks. It might be okay during battle sims, but when you're actually on the battlefield...

spans.text: (Sigh) You know, I get scared every time I see you plunge into the enemy ranks. It might be okay during battle sims, but when you're actually on the battlefield...

units.rawText: Relax, relax, I'll be fine.
units.displayText: Relax, relax, I'll be fine.

spans.text: Relax, relax, I'll be fine.

units.rawText: What do you mean, "You'll be fine"?! You don't have pain sensors so you don't know when you're hurt, and you've always been the battle maniac type.
units.displayText: What do you mean, "You'll be fine"?! You don't have pain sensors so you don't know when you're hurt, and you've always been the battle maniac type.

spans.text: What do you mean, "You'll be fine"?! You don't have pain sensors so you don't know when you're hurt, and you've always been the battle maniac type.

units.rawText: You just keep ripping and tearing and neglect your rear defense while you're doing it. You think it'll be fine when the enemy decides to exploit that opening?
units.displayText: You just keep ripping and tearing and neglect your rear defense while you're doing it. You think it'll be fine when the enemy decides to exploit that opening?

spans.text: You just keep ripping and tearing and neglect your rear defense while you're doing it. You think it'll be fine when the enemy decides to exploit that opening?

units.rawText: Aw, but I've got you behind me, right? Surely you wouldn't let the enemy backstab me.
units.displayText: Aw, but I've got you behind me, right? Surely you wouldn't let the enemy backstab me.

spans.text: Aw, but I've got you behind me, right? Surely you wouldn't let the enemy backstab me.

units.rawText: But I won't always be with you...
units.displayText: But I won't always be with you...

spans.text: But I won't always be with you...

units.rawText: Look, I know you're worried about me, Persicaria. But I'm not some frenzied berserker who doesn't care if she lives or dies. The reason why I can go all out like this is because I know you guys have my back.
units.displayText: Look, I know you're worried about me, Persicaria. But I'm not some frenzied berserker who doesn't care if she lives or dies. The reason why I can go all out like this is because I know you guys have my back.

spans.text: Look, I know you're worried about me, Persicaria. But I'm not some frenzied berserker who doesn't care if she lives or dies. The reason why I can go all out like this is because I know you guys have my back.

units.rawText: So relax, when I really can't handle it, I'll yell, "Persicaria, heal me" or something!
units.displayText: So relax, when I really can't handle it, I'll yell, "Persicaria, heal me" or something!

spans.text: So relax, when I really can't handle it, I'll yell, "Persicaria, heal me" or something!

units.rawText: Make sure you don't leave me high and dry when I do!
units.displayText: Make sure you don't leave me high and dry when I do!

spans.text: Make sure you don't leave me high and dry when I do!

units.rawText: Pfft... If Antonina were there, she'd probably go, "Then perish," or something.
units.displayText: Pfft... If Antonina were there, she'd probably go, "Then perish," or something.

spans.text: Pfft... If Antonina were there, she'd probably go, "Then perish," or something.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, but you're here now, Persicaria. So watch my back, yeah!
units.displayText: Hahahaha, but you're here now, Persicaria. So watch my back, yeah!

spans.text: Hahahaha, but you're here now, Persicaria. So watch my back, yeah!

units.rawText: I'm happy, truly I am. I'm glad we can stand on the battlefield together, that we can fight together...
units.displayText: I'm happy, truly I am. I'm glad we can stand on the battlefield together, that we can fight together...

spans.text: I'm happy, truly I am. I'm glad we can stand on the battlefield together, that we can fight together...

units.rawText: But we shouldn't be standing on opposite sides. So please, put your weapon down, I'll take you back to the Oasis. I'm sure there's a way to help cleanse your Entropization.
units.displayText: But we shouldn't be standing on opposite sides. So please, put your weapon down, I'll take you back to the Oasis. I'm sure there's a way to help cleanse your Entropization.

spans.text: But we shouldn't be standing on opposite sides. So please, put your weapon down, I'll take you back to the Oasis. I'm sure there's a way to help cleanse your Entropization.

units.rawText: Please, don't continue this pointless fighting any longer...
units.displayText: Please, don't continue this pointless fighting any longer...

spans.text: Please, don't continue this pointless fighting any longer...

units.rawText: ...It's not pointless.
units.displayText: ...It's not pointless.

spans.text: ...It's not pointless.

units.rawText: Sol lowers her head. Her voice is especially quiet, and I can feel her pouring her strength into her hands, as though she's fighting something invisible.
units.displayText: Sol lowers her head. Her voice is especially quiet, and I can feel her pouring her strength into her hands, as though she's fighting something invisible.

spans.text: Sol lowers her head. Her voice is especially quiet, and I can feel her pouring her strength into her hands, as though she's fighting something invisible.

units.rawText: I don't know you.
units.displayText: I don't know you.

spans.text: I don't know you.

units.rawText: No, I'm sure you remember.
units.displayText: No, I'm sure you remember.

spans.text: No, I'm sure you remember.

units.rawText: I know you can recall us; me, everyone, the Oasis...
units.displayText: I know you can recall us; me, everyone, the Oasis...

spans.text: I know you can recall us; me, everyone, the Oasis...

units.rawText: I'm having more and more trouble coping with the strength in her arms. I sidestep to avoid her strikes, just like I practiced, then seek her hands in the flames and hold them tight.
units.displayText: I'm having more and more trouble coping with the strength in her arms. I sidestep to avoid her strikes, just like I practiced, then seek her hands in the flames and hold them tight.

spans.text: I'm having more and more trouble coping with the strength in her arms. I sidestep to avoid her strikes, just like I practiced, then seek her hands in the flames and hold them tight.

units.rawText: You once held me with these hands and told me that the Oasis was our home...
units.displayText: You once held me with these hands and told me that the Oasis was our home...

spans.text: You once held me with these hands and told me that the Oasis was our home...

units.rawText: <size=40>Uwaaahhh— Persicaria!</size>
units.displayText: Uwaaahhh— Persicaria!

spans.text: Uwaaahhh— Persicaria!

units.rawText: Haha, don't jump me like that.
units.displayText: Haha, don't jump me like that.

spans.text: Haha, don't jump me like that.

units.rawText: Wah... I thought I would have to drift by myself forever...
units.displayText: Wah... I thought I would have to drift by myself forever...

spans.text: Wah... I thought I would have to drift by myself forever...

units.rawText: I can say the same... it is fantastic to see you again.
units.displayText: I can say the same... it is fantastic to see you again.

spans.text: I can say the same... it is fantastic to see you again.

units.rawText: Let's go. We'll go meet our new friends, along with Knot and Lind.
units.displayText: Let's go. We'll go meet our new friends, along with Knot and Lind.

spans.text: Let's go. We'll go meet our new friends, along with Knot and Lind.

units.rawText: But even if we're together, what are we going to do? The Neural Cloud Sector is already impossible to locate...
units.displayText: But even if we're together, what are we going to do? The Neural Cloud Sector is already impossible to locate...

spans.text: But even if we're together, what are we going to do? The Neural Cloud Sector is already impossible to locate...

units.rawText: The Professor has a private Sector, named the <color=orange>"Oasis"</color>. We'll head there.
units.displayText: The Professor has a private Sector, named the "Oasis". We'll head there.

spans.text: The Professor has a private Sector, named the
"Oasis"
. We'll head there.
